blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla on Saturday said Information and Communications Technology Secretary Henry Aguda has resigned from his post. “Nag-resign (He resigned),” Remulla said when asked about Aguda during his radio show at DZRH. “Tinanggap na yung resignation (His resignation was already accepted).” Malacañang, however, has yet to confirm Aguda’s resignation. (This is a developing story.)... Keep on reading: DICT Secretary Henry Aguda has resigned, says Ombudsman Remulla
